hook: A rivalry that ran for over 20 years. Last Evo vs the STI. Tested 0.12 s apart.

stories.a: Big 2.5 boxer, that rumble, and a driver-adjustable centre diff. Lighter and quicker in the test, but dearer.
stories.b: Mitsubishi's last ever Evo. Smaller 2.0 with more power and torque, and it was the cheaper one new.
stories.take: The Evo wins the dyno sheet. The STI wins the stopwatch.

_sources: WRX STI Premium MY16: Carsales research 2016 Subaru WRX STI Premium (price when new $55,390, 221 kW, 407 Nm, 10.4 L/100km, kerb 1,537 kg)
